verdict.rationale: Lium lets users and agents control when pods and their data go away. Pods can be given a TTL, end time or spend cap after which they are deleted, and agents can remove pods programmatically. However, local volumes are backed up every 6 hours and kept for a fixed 2 days, and persistent Volumes outlive pods, with no documented deletion guarantee for either. missing for 10: user-configurable backup retention or opt-out, documented deletion of backups and Volumes, account/data deletion controls, a data-retention policy, independent corroboration.
